Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter. Mix in the sugar, then add the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until combined, then mix in the chocolate chunks. Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter.
